趋势线使用仓库中现有的每日快照；项目按这段可用历史的 Star 净增量排序。纵轴为每个项目自身范围，不能用线条斜率跨项目比较绝对规模。Sparklines use the daily snapshots currently available in the repository. Projects are ranked by net stars across that period. Each chart has its own vertical scale, so slopes do not compare absolute scale across projects.

如何阅读：How to read: “首次收录”没有前值，因此不计算增量；单次变化超过前值 5% 或 1,000 Stars 会标记复核。多日卡片只描述已有快照区间，不把不足 7 天的数据包装成“7 日趋势”。“New” has no prior value. A single-capture change above 5% of the prior count or 1,000 stars is flagged for review. Multi-day cards describe only the available snapshot period and never label a shorter window as a seven-day trend.
